# Public Band schema audit fixtures

Current positive fixtures are generated from `BandPublicSchemaTestSupport.raw_time_reversal_representation_fixture()` through the normal `prepare_band_representation` workflow and its actual HDF5 writer. Tests do not edit a historical file header to create a current artifact.

`former_normal_prepared_1_16.h5` is the unmodified formal writer output of the same raw synthetic input and normal preparation helper, produced with Julia 1.10.12. Its recorded schema is 1.16 and its preparation status is PASS_WITH_WARNINGS. It is used only as a frozen content baseline; the current public reader rejects its old header. The comparison permits only root wire version, generation time, and Julia runtime identity differences, requires the new runtime identity to equal the running VERSION, and compares every other dataset/type/shape/numeric byte/attribute/digest exactly.

`former_complete_1_17.h5` was generated by the former writer with explicit complete mode metadata and a two-k-point spinor time-reversal representation. It is retained only for negative old-format/header tests; it is not a source for current positive artifacts or a supported migration example.

Both original files and their scientific/preparation digests are unchanged and sealed in SHA256SUMS. These are synthetic engineering fixtures and do not establish material-level physics or production eligibility.
